item.title: hono 4.13.16 (npm) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: Affects: `mount()` in `hono/mount` and `app.mount()`. A dynamic prefix such as `/api/:tenant/*` was removed by the length of the route pattern. The forwarded path was also re-normalized by the URL parser, so a decoded `\` became `/` and `..` collapsed. Both let a crafted request… Release notes: https://github.com/honojs/hono/releases/tag/v4.13.16
